_description: Haltech Nexus/Elite ECU Broadcast CAN Protocol v2.0 - full channel set
_notes: Haltech Broadcast CAN Protocol v2.0 (requires Nexus 1.25+ / Elite 3.11+), formerly Haltech CAN Dash Protocol
Bus: 1 Mbit/s, 11-bit IDs, big-endian data (reverseEndianness set on all multi-byte params)
Pressures broadcast absolute in kPa, converted to Bar; relative channels subtract 101.3 kPa (add -1.013)
Temperatures broadcast in Kelvin (x/10), converted to degC (add -273.15)
Tyre, ride height and 0x6FF pressure channels report raw 0 on sensor error (no signal / calibrating / timeout)
0x701 Fuel Mileage Instant position overlaps AC Temp in the PDF (4-5 vs 5-6); assumed bytes 6-7
0x6FF Transfer Case / AC / Power Steering pressures use y = x/100 - 101.3 kPa as printed (max ~2.2 Bar - verify on a real ECU; x/10 may be correct)

Omitted from the PDF: Combined Gear (0x370, same data as Gear/Gear Selector Position on 0x470), Cruise Input State bitfield (0x472), Generic Output Values/States (0x380/0x6F7, mode-dependent raw), Generic Sensors 1-10 (0x3E7-0x3E9, scaling depends on user-configured sensor type: V=x/1000, kPa=x/10-101.3, kPa abs=x/10, K=x/10, %=x/10), Nitrous Enable/Override switch banks (0x473 bytes 5-6), internal PDM frame (0x700, see Haltech Multiplexed CAN protocol)
Engine Limiter/RPM Limiter/Cut Percentage Functions are enums per the Haltech 'Engine Limiting Functions' table (table not printed in doc v2.0, values shown raw)
